text:
IncidentBot: :rotating_light: ALERT: elevated TLS handshake errors observed for api.redwood-inference.com in ap-southeast-2 (Sydney). Error ratio ~14% over 4m. Paging on-call.

adele.ops: Ack. Taking page. michael-sre can you own infra/network? carlos-net please stand by for packet captures.

michael-sre: Oncall ack. Dashboard shows spike in TLS handshake phase failures and increased 524/525 from edge NLB -> app cluster. Pulling edge proxy and NLB logs.

deploy-bot: Heads-up: cert-20260502-0830 rotation completed 7m ago to edge proxies and NLB TLS listeners. No deploy errors in pipeline.

support-jen: Customer noise: several enterprise customers in APAC report immediate connection resets during model calls. Collecting request ids and examples.

priya-eng: quick repro from my laptop to edge VIP yields intermittent resets. curl gives: 
```
$ curl -v https://api.redwood-inference.com/health
* Connected to api.redwood-inference.com (13.54.23.77) port 443 (#0)
* TLS 1.3 (IN), TLS_AES_256_GCM_SHA384, ClientHello sizes large
* server handshake failure
* Recv failure: Connection reset by peer
* Closing connection 0
curl: (56) Recv failure: Connection reset by peer
```

priya-eng: openssl s_client shows the socket sometimes closes right after peer starts sending certs; sometimes intermediate missing. Example snippet:
```
$ openssl s_client -connect 13.54.23.77:443 -servername api.redwood-inference.com -showcerts
CONNECTED(00000003)
depth=0 CN = api.redwood-inference.com
verify error:num=20:unable to get local issuer certificate
Certificate chain
 0 s:/CN=api.redwood-inference.com
   i:/CN=Example Intermediate CA
write:errno=104
---
no peer certificate available
```

carlos-net: tcpdump from edge host shows clear ICMP frag-needed messages: 
```
14:12:03.456789 IP 13.54.23.77.443 > 172.31.12.9.52011: Flags [P.], seq 1:1500, ack 1, win 64240, length 1499
14:12:03.456792 IP 172.31.12.9 > 13.54.23.77: ICMP 13.54.23.77 unreachable - fragmentation needed and DF set (mtu = 1380)
```

carlos-net: ICMP Type3 Code4 shows PMTU suggestion 1380; ClientHello sizes measured ~1500 which would force fragmentation. Some network components on the path appear to drop fragments or drop ICMP, causing the TLS handshake to fail mid-flight.

samantha-noc: Also seeing intermittent BGP route change for transit peer 203.0.113.1 around same time (14:10 UTC) - temporary asymmetry possible. Opening NOC ticket with transit.

aurora-sre: Hypothesis set: 1) cert rotation produced incomplete chain on some edge nodes (maybe cert bundle generation missed intermediate); 2) PMTU/ICMP handling / provider route asymmetry caused large ClientHello to be dropped; 3) combination led to handshake failures concentrated in APAC.

michael-sre: We'll run two parallel mitigations: (A) rollback cert-20260502-0830 on a canary set of edge proxies; (B) reduce MTU on canary edge interfaces to 1380 to avoid fragmentation. Also temp enable TLS record size limit on proxy to split ClientHello if supported. adele, prepare customer note.

adele.ops: drafting message now. Will call out we're investigating TLS errors and implementing mitigations.

deploy-bot: rolling back cert-20260502-0830 -> target cert bundle cert-20260501-2200 on canary proxies.

carlos-net: applied `ip link set eth0 mtu 1380` on canary-edge-3 and started packet captures. Observing handshake success rate improving on that node.

priya-eng: On the canary with rollback + mtu change, openssl shows full cert chain and curl succeeds: 
```
$ curl -I https://canary-edge-3.ap-southeast-2
HTTP/1.1 200 OK
```

support-jen: Customers routed through canary nodes report restored connectivity. Updating support cases to mitigated.

samantha-noc: Transit provider confirms a brief BGP flap and is investigating potential ICMP filtering on their IX fabric. Ticket #NOC-7721 created.

aurora-sre: Draft timeline: 
- 14:05 UTC cert-20260502-0830 rotation deployed to edge fleet
- 14:09 UTC monitoring alerted: TLS handshake failures spike in ap-southeast-2
- 14:11 UTC initial triage: tcpdump shows ICMP frag-needed (MTU 1380); openssl shows intermittent missing intermediate certs; NOC observes transit BGP flap
- 14:14 UTC canary mitigations: rollback cert bundle on canary + set MTU 1380 on canary-edge -> canary recovery observed by 14:17 UTC
- 14:20 UTC initiated fleet rollback of cert and staged MTU change; engaged transit provider

michael-sre: Mitigation details: rolled back to cert-20260501-2200 which includes validated intermediate chain, patched proxy cert-serving logic to ensure complete bundle. Temporarily lowered edge MTU and enabled TLS ClientHello chunking on proxies to avoid oversized records.

carlos-net: Uploaded full pcaps and traceroutes to incident artifact bucket and shared with provider. Found path asymmetry: some client-to-edge flows traversed a transit that enforces DF and drops fragments. Provider investigating.

aurora-sre: In-thread RCA note: root cause is multi-factor: a new cert bundle that on some nodes failed to provide full intermediate chain combined with a PMTU/network asymmetry that caused large TLS ClientHello packets to be dropped. The certificate issue exposed the fragility because incomplete chain caused additional packet exchange patterns that interacted poorly with broken PMTU.

priya-eng: Follow-ups I will take: add cert bundle sanity check in rotation pipeline that verifies full chain from multiple front-door IPs and under simulated MTU constraints; add synthetic large-ClientHello test against front-door endpoints.

michael-sre: Network follow-ups: 1) add alert for ICMP frag-needed spikes and for handshake failures correlated with ICMP; 2) validate NLB and proxy MTU & path; 3) run a recovery plan to revert MTU once provider confirms fix.

adele.ops: I'll finish the incident writeup and customer postmortem summary, include link to pcaps and ticket numbers. Scheduling 48h follow-up review. Handoff to next oncall in 8m. Great coordination. :clap:

IncidentBot: Severity set to S2 — mitigations applied, monitoring.

support-jen: marking customer escalations as mitigated; will reopen if any regression.

aurora-sre: Post-incident runbook items to include: cert-rotation preflight checks (multi-ip), synthetic tests for large ClientHello, alerting for PMTU/ICMP anomalies, runbook steps for quick cert rollback and MTU adjustment, and carrier engagement checklist.

adele.ops: thanks team. linking artifacts and pcaps in the postmortem in 30m. Handing off now.

(End of thread)
